title: {RECIPE_NAME} Gradio endpoint contract
description: Auto-generated by tools/generate_export.py. Spring backend treats this as the source of truth and generates a Java client (e.g. via openapi-generator-cli or hand-written RestTemplate). The schema mirrors what gradio.Interface exposes when serve_via_gradio=true is set in recipe.yaml.

path.description: Gradio always exposes /run/predict. Backend treats this as the canonical path.

url_env_var.description: Backend reads the actual host from this env var (the Gradio share URL).

request.description: Gradio wraps your inputs as {"data": [arg1, arg2, ...]}.

data.description: Position-based input list — matches the parameter order of inference_handler.infer().
Position-based output list — matches return values of inference_handler.infer().

items.$comment: TODO recipe author: replace with actual output shape

errors.description: Failure modes the backend must distinguish.

gradio_url_unset.description: AI_GRADIO_URL env not set — backend should return 503 to frontend.

gradio_url_expired.description: Colab session ended — share URL invalid. Backend retries against newest URL from team Slack/Notion channel.

vram_oom.description: Model returned OOM — backend should return 413.

model_cold_start.description: First request after Colab restart can take 30-60s. Backend timeout should be ≥ 90s.

_template_marker.description: Recipe authors: edit the `request.data.items` and `response.data.items` shapes to match your actual inference_handler.infer() signature. The generator only fills RECIPE_NAME and structural defaults; semantics are yours.
